name: Shapes of libpostal's British Fixtures
description: The 29 British and one Manx parser fixtures in libpostal's test/test_parser.c (MIT), each written again as an original address of the same shape: the same parts in the same order, with the same punctuation, under other names, numbers and inward codes. libpostal's inputs are third-party addresses, so none is copied. Where a part has no field here (libpostal's state_district is a county or a region), it is a county when it is one.

shapes.input: The Reading Room 40-44 Curtain Rd, Hoxton, London, Greater London, England, EC2A 3AA, United Kingdom
